prog='''
from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
            stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop()
                if (a,b) in seen or g[a][b]==bg: continue
                seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b,g[a][b]))
                for di in(-1,0,1):
                    for dj in(-1,0,1):
                        ni,nj=a+di,b+dj
                        if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and g[ni][nj]!=bg and (ni,nj) not in seen: stack.append((ni,nj))
            comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len,reverse=True)
    templ=comps[0]
    ci=round(sum(p[0] for p in templ)/len(templ)); cj=round(sum(p[1] for p in templ)/len(templ))
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for comp in comps[1:]:
        for (i,j,v) in comp:
            for (ti,tj,tv) in templ:
                ni,nj=i+ti-ci,j+tj-cj
                if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W: out[ni][nj]=tv
    return out
'''
